prompt: Flop denial spot versus overcards: choose action.
why_v1: Denial spots use the bet branch to keep weaker overcards from catching up for free.
feedback_acceptable_v1: Acceptable. Calling keeps the pot smaller, but raising is preferred because it keeps weaker overcards from catching up for free.
feedback_correct_v1: Correct. Denial line is bet in this spot.
feedback_incorrect_v1: Incorrect. This denial spot wants a bet now so weaker overcards do not get a free turn.
